scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm dbmate up && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml run --rm -e DATABASE_URL=postgres://postgres@postgres:5432/velio_test?sslmode=disable dbmate up
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/api && tsc --noEmit -p packages/contracts && tsc --noEmit -p infra/aws
scripts.aws:synth: AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 bun run --cwd infra/aws cdk synth
scripts.aws:diff: AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 bun run --cwd infra/aws cdk diff
scripts.aws:deploy: AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 bun run --cwd infra/aws cdk deploy
scripts.aws:destroy: AWS_REGION=eu-west-2 bun run --cwd infra/aws cdk destroy
